source: The structured effects of the skills the system applies by itself, written out by hand from the Effect text of the Skills tab of the Reference Sheet. The notation is explained at the top of module/rules/skills.mjs. A skill that is not listed is shown with its Effect text only. 'left' says what part of a listed skill is still for the table.

Lethal Grace.left: Tier 2 is read as level 21. The damage on a Critical Hit that would deal none is for the table.

Repel.left: The step backwards after initiating combat is for the table.

Critical Mastery.left: Critical counts half of DEX, so one and a half times DEX is a further quarter of it.

Nihil.left: Stopping the foe's Choose skills is for the table.

Ruined Sky.left: The higher multiplier with a Flying-effective weapon or with Giantkiller is for the table.

Noncombatant.left: Giving no EXP when defeated is for the table.

Brash Assault.left: Read as the unit being at half HP or less.

Sweep.left: Whether the unit may counter-attack on the following enemy phase is for the table.

Offensive Tactics.left: The damage allies gain against the same enemy is for the table.

Future Sight.left: The Dodge and Critical Avoid gained from a heavy hit are for the table.

Bloodlust.left: The 5 damage the unit takes afterwards is for the table.

Armored Boots.left: Read from the unit's HP now rather than at the start of its turn.

Artillerist.left: Halving the effect with Bolts is for the table.

Cruelty.left: The Hit gained for each stat debuff on the enemy is for the table.

Opportunist.left: Applied whenever the foe makes no counter-attack; a foe countering with a Staff is for the table.

Pride.left: The further Hit and Critical for each Class Tier the enemy is lower are for the table.

Underdog.left: The further Dodge and Critical Avoid for each Class Tier the enemy is higher are for the table.

Observant.left: The +2 HST is for the table.

Blessing of Vesta.left: Triangle Advantage against Fire tomes and the immunity to Burn are for the table.

Radiance.left: The enemy's lowered Accuracy afterwards is for the table.

Hero's Blood.left: The boost to the unit and its allies for a turn is for the table.

Blue Flame.left: The further damage for each adjacent ally is for the table.

Burning Desire.left: The effect of the Charm staff and the second and third turn of Burn are for the table.

Savage.left: Halving the target's DEX afterwards is for the table.

Tear.left: Reducing the enemy's LUK to 0 is for the table.

Colossus.left: The Might gained for each point of CON over the target's is for the table.

Synergy.left: The Hit and Dodge on the following turn are for the table.

Brutal Strength.left: Counted with physical weapons, which add STR; a weapon that adds another stat is for the table.

Expiacion.left: Read as a third of DEF or RES added to the damage of physical or magical attacks, and a third of STR or MAG taken off the damage of physical or magical hits. A weapon that adds or targets another stat than its kind usually does is for the table.

Insight.left: Halving the target's DEF and RES afterwards is for the table.

Amplify.left: The stronger or longer effects of the weapon are for the table.

Arcane Blade.left: Targeting RES is for the table.

Corona.left: The target's lowered RES after combat is for the table.

Pounce.left: Trading places with the enemy after combat is for the table.

Golden Lotus.left: The Dodge gained for two turns is for the table.

Holy Vestments.left: The damage added to the unit's next attack is for the table.

Misery Mirror.left: The foe's lowered DEX and SPD are for the table.

Glare.left: Rolled when the attack hits; an attack that misses is for the table.

Panoply.left: The higher chance when the attack is also blocked with a Shield is for the table.

Shieldstrike.left: The Hit, Dodge and Critical gained when the damage falls below zero are for the table.

Scale Shield.left: The damage the attacker takes when nothing gets through is for the table.

Kestrel.left: The +5 SPD is for the table.

Roar.left: Stunning the enemy is for the table.

Iaido.left: Counted for the unit's next attack in the same combat; a next attack in a later combat is for the table.

Punish.left: Applied when the unit cannot counter-attack; a counter-attack that would deal no damage is for the table.

Rage.left: The immunity to Sleep is for the table.

Holy Conduit.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the HP restored to an adjacent ally is for the table.

Full Tilt.left: The +2 HST gained with each MOV is for the table.

Flurry.left: The system only says when this takes effect; moving and attacking again, once per turn, is for the table.

Cleave.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the damage to an enemy adjacent to the target is for the table.

Cold Rain.left: Once per turn: the system applies it once in every fight; a second fight in the same turn is for the table.

Rencounter.left: The ATK for blocking an attack is for the table.

Standardbearer.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the stat granted to each nearby ally is for the table.

Onrush.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the further action, the first time on a map, is for the table.

Lead by Example.left: The system only says when this takes effect; refreshing the adjacent allies, once per turn, is for the table.

Bloodthirst.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the healing at the start of the next three turns is for the table.

Fearsome Blow.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the damage to enemies near the target is for the table.

Encore.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the further action, once per turn, is for the table.

Hook.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the STR gained on the next turn is for the table.

Galeforce.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the further action, once per turn, is for the table.

Convalescence.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the healing at the start of the next turn is for the table.

Runemail.left: The additional +1 MAG for a hit that deals no damage is for the table.

Ruse.left: The debuff growing by 1 when promoting is for the table.

Savage Blow.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the damage to enemies near the target is for the table.

Influence.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the HP adjacent allies recover and the stronger Motivate and Rally are for the table.

Scorch.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the damage and Burn for enemies adjacent to the target are for the table.

Seal.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the two stats of the enemy that are lowered are for the table.

Hit and Run.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the move and the HP gained for it are for the table.

Raucous Roar.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the Refresh, its limit per turn and the HST for a kill are for the table.

Mug.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the gold stolen, once per enemy, is for the table.

Despoil.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the Bullion is for the table.

Plunder.left: Paid for a kill by an attack in a fight the system rolls; an enemy defeated any other way is for the table. With Greed on the unit as well it pays 100 Gold for each level.

Robbery.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the D3 and what it gives are for the table.

Forager.left: The system only says when this takes effect; whether the unit stands on a Forest, Thicket or Wardwood, the healing shown if it does, and Cantoing without their movement penalties are for the table.

Omen.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the random enemy that is Rattled, and Rattling every enemy when that one is killed, are for the table.

Holy Aura.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the healing of allies within 3 spaces is for the table.

Bewitch.left: The system only says when this takes effect; Berserking the adjacent enemies, and forcing the effect with its cooldown, are for the table.

Invincible.left: The system only says when this takes effect; taking no damage for the turn, and not activating on consecutive turns, are for the table.

Lottery.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the stats that are boosted and by how much are for the table.

Sharpen Claws.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the Might and Critical of the unit's next attack are for the table.

Shade.left: The system only says when this takes effect; being untargetable in the following Non-Player Phases is for the table.

Sky-Clearing Cut.left: Negating the foe's Shield is for the table.

Shatter.left: Negating Shields, the target's lowered DEF and RES afterwards and its lost Shield uses are for the table.

Umbra.left: Halving the unit's current HP is for the table.

Capote.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Flee.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Gigas Grip.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Hustle.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Singular Strike.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Stunt.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Spellshield.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Animus.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Animose.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Body Blow.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Throw.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect, and the shorter cooldown of 1 turn when the foe is not moved, are for the table.

Juna Oil.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Fulmination.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Rebuke.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Fast Fingers.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Cannon.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Fatality.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Primal Fury.left: The temporary HP are for the table.

Fortress.left: Not being moved by anything such as Shove or Entrap is for the table.

Immolation.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Provoke.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Unnerve.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Teleport.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Breath Weapon.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Hemorrhage.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Blast.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Foul Play.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Enlighten.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Waterwheel.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Sabotage.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Howl.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Death Grip.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Confiteor.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Override.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Smoke Bomb.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Lunar Cry.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Malaise.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Cheer.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Deathmatch.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Jeer.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Maneuver.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Overwatch.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Pebble.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Protect.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Salve.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Avert.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Sacrifice.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Spell Trap.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Haymaker.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Mark.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Camouflage.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Sentry.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Rally.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Harsh Command.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Forward Observation.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Art of War.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

To the Death.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Run.left: Making no action other than Waiting is for the table.

Fury.left: The 5 damage the unit takes after combat, which cannot kill, is for the table.

Blood Tide.left: The same for the ally that is chosen is for the table.

Wave The Flag.left: Not counter-attacking while in Flag stance, and the Shield Block Chance of allies within 3 spaces, are for the table.

Pulverize.left: DEF and RES are lowered for the whole fight; their return once the follow-up attack is made is for the table.

Robust.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Master Horseman.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Odds Manipulator.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Dogma.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Holy War.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Battery.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect, and using it again at a penalty and on a cooldown, are for the table.

Deflect Arrows.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Snatch Arrows.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Sidearm.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Redirect.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Alarm.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Suppress.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Aquila.left: The +1 additional attack in place of the follow-up, for a unit that can already follow up, is for the table.

Honor Among Thieves.left: Not being Stolen from is for the table.

Harmonize.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; which allies within 2 spaces carry a Tome that can be used, and +1 Might for each, are for the table.

Loyalty.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the ally chosen at the start of the map, and +10 Hit and Critical within 2 spaces of them, are for the table.

Spotting.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; which enemies an ally has in its LoS, and the Damage, Hit and Critical against them, are for the table.

Giant Swing.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the MOV the unit has left, and +4 Hit and +2 Critical for each point of it, are for the table.

Momentum.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the spaces the unit moved, and +0.5 damage for each, are for the table.

Adieu.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the tiles moved using Canto, and +2 Dodge for each until the start of the unit's next turn, are for the table.

Agility.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the MOV the unit has left, and +3 Dodge for each point of it, are for the table.

Hastilude.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; whether the Lance was equipped at the start of the turn, the spaces moved, and +0.5 Might for each on its next attack, are for the table.

Leonine Lunge.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the MOV the unit has left, and +1 Might for each point of it, are for the table.

Charge.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; whether the unit made a full movement, and +25% damage if it did, are for the table.

Moxie.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; whether the unit has yet to move, and +35% STR and +50% weapon Might if it has, are for the table.

Outrider.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the spaces moved, and +3 Critical and Dodge for each until the start of the unit's next turn, are for the table.

Natural Cover.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; whether the unit stands on terrain with an effect, and -2 damage taken if it does, are for the table.

Terrain Fighter.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the terrain type chosen, and +15 Hit and +1 Damage while on it, are for the table.

Sojourner.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; the Minor and Major terrain types picked, and their bonuses while on them, are for the table.

Forester.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; whether the unit stands on a Forest or Thicket, +10 Hit and Critical if it does, and negating the terrain bonuses of a foe that does, are for the table.

Open Assault.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; whether the unit stands on terrain without any effects, and +20 Hit and +3 Damage if it does, are for the table.

Pathfinder.left: The system only says when this takes effect; whether the unit stands on terrain with no effects, and the +2 MOV if it does, are for the table.

Altesse.left: The system only names this skill for allies within 2 spaces; whether an ally is of the gender chosen, and the -3 damage it then takes, are for the table.

Advisor.left: The system only names this skill for allies within 2 spaces; whether an ally's highest weapon rank is of the kind chosen, and the +3 damage it then deals, are for the table.

Teshuah.left: The +1 HST gained with each is for the table.

Authority.left: With the Authority & Leadership module in use the skill is a Leadership Star, given on the unit's sheet. Raising the boosts in place of a Promotion or Mastery Skill is for the table.

Vindication.left: The system only says when this takes effect; +2 END for that ally during the combat, once per turn, and +3 ATK for the unit until the end of its next turn, are for the table.

Divine Authority.left: With the Authority & Leadership module in use the skill is 3 Leadership Stars, given on the unit's sheet.

Ploy.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the stat chosen, and -4 to it until the end of the turn for each of the enemies named whose RES the unit's RES surpasses, are for the table.

Staredown.left: Halving the MOV of all enemies in the unit's LoS as an action is for the table.

Mountaineer.left: Tier 2 is read as level 21. Whether the unit stands on a Hill tile, and +1 DEF if it does, are for the table, as is crossing Mountain, Peak and Cliff tiles.

Privateer.left: Tier 2 is read as level 21. Whether the unit stands on a River tile, and +1 DEF if it does, are for the table, as is crossing Water, Sea and Ocean tiles.

Bypass.left: The system does not see movement: declare the skill once the unit has moved through an enemy, before it attacks that enemy. Moving through 1 enemy per turn, and the first enemy costing no MOV with Nimble, are for the table.

Flyby.left: Moving through enemies, ending a turn on the same space as another unit, and not blocking enemy movement there, are for the table.

Canto.left: The system only says when this takes effect; moving the rest of the unit's movement after it attacked is for the table.

Tackle.left: The system only says when this takes effect; whether the unit may Shove its target, and Shoving it (or Smiting it, with Smite), are for the table.

Action Surge.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the second action of the turn is for the table.

Lineage.left: Experience given by hand (the GM's awards, bEXP) is typed on the sheet as it is, and is for the table to multiply.

Greenhorn.left: bEXP, like any experience given by hand, is typed on the sheet as it is: the system doubles only what it awards itself.

Elite.left: Experience given by hand (the GM's awards, bEXP) is typed on the sheet as it is, and is for the table to multiply.

Guidance.left: "1.5x extra EXP" is read as 1.5 times the experience. Experience given by hand (the GM's awards, bEXP) is typed on the sheet as it is, and is for the table to multiply.

Loot.left: Gold for an enemy defeated outside an attack of a fight the system rolls (by a skill's damage after combat, or in a fight run by hand) is for the table.

Payment.left: Only the growth rates rolled by the Level Up button count: a promotion that takes the place of a level up, and stats a class gives at a level, pay nothing by themselves.

Revitalize.left: The +1 to Charm or Intelligence, when the level up raised one, is for the table, as is a promotion that takes the place of a level up.

Aptitude.left: The three growth rates are picked on the skill's sheet. Nothing stops them being changed afterwards; that the choices cannot be changed is for the table to keep.

Perfect Shot.left: The system does not see movement: declare the skill before an attack in a turn the unit has not moved in. A ranged attack is one with a weapon that itself reaches 2 tiles or more.

Telekinesis.left: The penalties apply when the unit attacks from further than its weapon itself reaches; within the weapon's own Range it attacks as usual.

Longarm.left: Switch the skill on to attack as Longarm does: from next to the foe as a Midrange attack, from 2 tiles with a weapon that does not reach that far itself. That these attacks cannot be made through obstacles or units is for the table.

Reach.left: With tokens on a square grid, an attack on a diagonal neighbour with a melee weapon that reaches 1 tile starts at a distance of 1, where the foe answers as usual; without tokens, type 1 as the distance.

Staff Fighter.left: The system lets any unit attack with a staff in hand; whether this unit may is for the table.

Proficient.left: The 5 WLV of the Weapon Level module are for the table: the system checks Weapon Ranks.

Aspected.left: The +1 Rank in the chosen magic type is given once, by hand, on the unit's proficiencies. Damage of that type that does not come from a weapon in a fight is for the table.

Preparedness.left: The system only names this skill for the table to check; changing the unit's weapon before the combat, when an enemy initiates, is for the table.

Arsonist.left: The Burn this unit inflicts in a fight deals 5% of maximum HP more for as many turns as it then has. Burn it causes in any other way is for the table.

Dragonskin.left: A condition put on the unit by hand is kept, and deals its damage. Damage from skills outside of a fight, such as Trample, is for the table.

Healthy.left: Rolled for conditions inflicted in a fight. For one put on the unit by hand (a staff, an item, a trap), roll the 50% before adding it.

Immunity.left: A condition put on the unit by hand is kept. A change another unit's skill left on it outside of a fight still shows among its lasting effects: what it takes off stats and combat stats is negated, anything else it does is for the table.

Blood for Blood.left: Applies to conditions an enemy inflicts in a fight. One inflicted in any other way is for the table.

Stagger.left: Applies to a Stun this unit inflicts in a fight, and to the damage of attacks. If the Stun is cured early, end the effect by hand on the enemy's Skills tab.

Reverb.left: Applies to Tremor that bursts in a fight, and to Tremor this unit inflicts in a fight.

Dark Calling.left: The system only says when this takes effect; spreading the condition to the units next to the target, for half its duration and at least 1 turn, is for the table.

Toxify.left: Put Poison on the unit once by hand; it then never runs out. Units that start or end their turn next to it have Toxify named on their turn card, and are given Poison by hand; a unit that is neither its ally nor its enemy is not named.

Balm.left: Applies when a staff is used on a targeted ally with the Use button. For a second Balm, add the skill again and pick another variant.

Live to Serve.left: Applies to staves that heal one target, used on a targeted unit with the Use button. Staves that heal several units are for the table.

Reciprocity.left: Applies to staves that heal one target, used on this unit by an ally with the Use button. Staves that heal several units are for the table.

Selfstaff.left: A staff that heals one target heals the unit itself when it is used with nobody targeted. Other beneficial staves used on itself, and staves for several units, are for the table.

Ambulance.left: The +5 HP applies to staves that heal one target, used with the Use button.

Maim & Mend.left: Applies to staves that heal one target and to items, used on a targeted ally. Other healing is for the table.

Venerable.left: Applies to staves that heal one target, used on a targeted ally with the Use button.

Requiescat.left: Applies when a staff heals a targeted ally. With several enemies equally near, or without tokens, the damage is named for the table to deal; healing with items or skills is for the table.

Staffsong.left: The system only says when this takes effect; refreshing the ally the staff was used on is for the table.

Powerstaff.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the extra movement and action, once per turn, are for the table.

Blessing.left: The staff's card shows the doubled Range beside the distance; the system does not stop a staff from being used out of range.

Staff Savant.left: Staves used with the Use button lose no use, and their card shows a Range of up to 10; the system does not stop a staff from being used out of range.

Power Chord.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table. Used together with other Refresh buffs its cooldown is 5 turns: set that on the skill's sheet after using it.

Favored.left: Applies to a fatal hit of an attack in a fight the system rolls; a blow dealt any other way (a skill's damage, a condition, a backfire) is for the table. The damage it takes none of afterwards is that of attacks and of skills in fights; conditions, staves and its own weapon backfiring are for the table. Its use comes back with a new encounter, or on the skill's sheet.

Guardian.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table: moving to the ally, the Rescue, the ally surviving on 1 HP, and dropping it at the start of the next turn.

Goddess's Blessing.left: A weapon is considered Blessed when its name or its Effect says so (the Blessed weapons and the tome Blessing): write "Blessed" into the Effect of any other weapon the table considers so. Non-Beorc attacks are those made with Laguz, Manakete and Taguel weapons. Damage outside of a fight (conditions, staves, skills used on it) is for the table.

Mantle.left: A weapon is considered Blessed when its name or its Effect says so (the Blessed weapons and the tome Blessing): write "Blessed" into the Effect of any other weapon the table considers so. Non-Beorc attacks are those made with Laguz, Manakete and Taguel weapons. Damage outside of a fight (conditions, staves, skills used on it) and stopping the foe's Choose skills are for the table.

Canto+.left: The system only says when this takes effect; moving the rest of the unit's movement, after it attacked or used a staff and after every other action its Effect lists, is for the table.

Rampart.left: Waiting is the Wait button. The allies' chance is rolled when a hit lands on them in a fight the system rolls, for units with tokens on the scene; damage dealt any other way is for the table. Put this on a unit with the Armored Special Quality: the system does not add it by itself.

Rouse.left: Used with its button as the unit's turn starts. The +1 HST of the Beast Special Quality is for the table. Put this on a unit with the Beast Special Quality: the system does not add it by itself.

Greed.left: Paid for a kill by an attack in a fight the system rolls; an enemy defeated any other way is for the table. With Plunder on the unit as well this rolls nothing, and Plunder pays 100 Gold for each level. Put this on a unit with the Bandit Special Quality: the system does not add it by itself.

Gregarious.left: The system only says when this takes effect; Shifting this unit and the Laguz next to it until the start of their next turn is for the table.

General.left: No condition is applied to it in a fight the system rolls; a condition put on it by hand is kept. Negating Lethality and Bane, and negative or forced movement, are for the table.

Roar of the Crowd.left: Applies while the unit is Waiting (the Wait button) with Rampart on it as an Item, for allies with tokens on the scene, by where they stand at the time; for a unit without a token the skill is shown and is for the table to apply. The Special Qualities added count for Rampart's buffs only.

Feral Instincts.left: Switched on, the Shift button works whatever the Shift Gauge holds, and a Shift gives 25% to stats, -1 MOV and half the experience the system awards; switch it off to Shift the usual way. The gauge still runs as usual: at 0 the unit reverts, and may Shift again at once.

Aggression.left: The Attack button works in humanoid form, and such a fight gives half of what a fight in humanoid form usually gives the Shift Gauge, rounded down. Putting Fists in its hands is done when it reverts; check the weapon before attacking.

Primal Tenacity.left: A new encounter leaves the Shift Gauge where it was and puts the unit in humanoid form. The Reset button of the sheet still sets the starting gauge.

Demiform.left: Used with its button as the unit's turn starts; it ends when its next turn starts. Experience given by hand is typed on the sheet as it is.

Draconic Fury.left: Counted for critical hits in fights the system rolls, for a unit with a Shift Gauge.

Formshift.left: The Shift button works whatever the Shift Gauge holds, and a stone never runs out of transformations. At 0 the gauge still reverts the unit, which may Shift again at once.

Primal Blast.left: The system only says when this takes effect; the damage to every adjacent foe, a quarter of this unit's STR (MAG with a Magestone), as it transforms for a fight is for the table.

Infection.left: The system only says when this takes effect; reviving the enemy as an allied revenant with halved stats, 1 HP, no skills and basic Claws is for the table.

Imitate.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table: copying the ally's attributes, and the limits on whom it may copy. Its Use button switches it on for 5 turns. Reverting earlier, the 2 turns it cannot be used after reverting, and the sixth turn Greater Imitate gives are set on the skill's sheet.

Rise.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table: press Use when an enemy this unit killed is revived, up to 3 times per map, and make the revived unit by hand.

Wildkin.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Spirit Call.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.

Conjure.left: The system keeps count of its use; its effect is for the table.
